parts.text:
Kris can go to school by bus or by taxi.
On any day the probability that Kris goes by bus is 0.9 .
When Kris goes by bus, the probability that she is late for school is 0.06 .
When she goes by taxi, the probability that she is late for school is 0.01 .

parts.label: i
